Container.Name: Jotist-CPU
Container.Overview:
Jotist turns audio and video into searchable transcripts, speaker labels, notes, and optional summaries and chat. Run local speech models on your own server and keep your recordings under your control.
This CPU option follows the latest stable release and requires no NVIDIA GPU. Model availability, memory requirements, and processing speed depend on the selected model. Models and runtime dependencies download when needed.
Application data, managed runtimes, and home/model caches are stored in three persistent appdata folders. Open the WebUI after installation to create the first account. Optional cloud transcription and LLM providers send content to the provider you configure.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: speech transcription speech-to-text whisper parakeet canary diarization audio stt ai
Container.Requires: 64-bit Intel or AMD processor (linux/amd64). Internet access and disk space for the selected models and runtime dependencies. RAM requirements vary by model.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port for Jotist. Choose an unused port if 8080 is already in use.

Config.Name: Application data
Config.Description: Persistent database, recordings, transcripts, settings, and generated signing secret. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Managed runtimes and models
Config.Description: Persistent Python environments and model files. Allow enough space for the models you select.

Config.Name: Home and download caches
Config.Description: Persistent Hugging Face, Torch, and package caches used by model runtimes.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for Jotist and its appdata files. 99 is Unraid's nobody user. Preserve the existing effective UID when reusing data.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for Jotist and its appdata files. 100 is Unraid's users group. Preserve the existing effective GID when reusing data.

Config.Name: Database path
Config.Description: Database file inside the container's application data folder.
